findings.detail: os.walk has no onerror callback and silently skips scan failures; a local PermissionError fixture yields zero files and zero partials. Only the active leaf is checked against symlinks, so a symlinked data ancestor is accepted. A complete fail-closed census and trusted ancestor/entry checks are required before startup_custody_gate may be true.
findings.title: Incomplete active-tree inventory can be accepted as zero partials

findings.detail: The deadline is checked only at loop entry, while each state/journal subprocess permits 330 seconds. A state read completing at 181 seconds is accepted without a post-I/O deadline check. Pass strictly positive remaining time into each bounded I/O and check again afterward.
findings.title: The advertised 180-second worker bound is not enforced across I/O

findings.detail: After worker2 is observed inactive the helper reads inventory/owners/timer without a final same-invocation worker check. A synthetic timer race publishes an old inactive archive_worker while current owners reports a new active worker. Use a bounded entire-attempt bracket and retain each raced/failed attempt.
findings.title: Worker proof is not coherent with later inventory, owners and timer observations

findings.detail: The design actually invokes canonical definition-only deployment verify; update the docstring to match that authorized read-only verification.
findings.title: The module contract incorrectly denies deployment verification
